value.answer: I'm glad you reached out, and I'm sorry things are hard enough that you need this. If it gets urgent where you are, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency room. For Toronto, the free option is the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy Program. It's publicly funded CBT for depression and anxiety, you don't need a health card, and you can self-refer at ontariohealth.ca/osp by filling out the referral form. An intake clinician checks whether it's a good fit, and it doesn't cover things like DBT, crisis support or unstructured talk therapy. For lower-cost options, student-intern training clinics see clients for about $50 a session under supervision, and some offer a free 15-minute consult. Toronto Community Psychotherapy & Counselling Centre offers free, income-based counselling, but that info is about 14 months old. I couldn't confirm that any of these are taking new clients right now, so it's worth calling to check.
